name: m2749-greening
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, Arabian desert region in the 7th century, bright fresh morning light, vibrant natural colours, high detail. The sun disc is NOT visible. No people, no animals, no buildings, no text. A wide open desert plain just after a winter rain: the reddish-gold sand is wet and darker, and fresh low green grass and tiny new sprouts spread in soft patches across it, thickest in the foreground and thinning toward the horizon. A few shallow rainwater puddles in the foreground reflect the bright sky. The last light rain is still falling thinly in the distance under grey-white clouds that are breaking apart into clear blue sky above. Low rocky hills on the horizon. Calm, hopeful mood.
